text.text_excerpt: This hotel was a great balance of location and value. It has a nice lobby and courtyard, rooms are nicely furnished, and best of all there were no bad or smokey smells like so many NOLA hotels. Everything was in good functional state. The massive number and variety of pillows in our king size room were a nice plus. The staff is helpful, friendly, and made concerted efforts to remember guests. "How was your dinner at...?" You don't have to walk far to find excellent food. I skipped the $32/day parking because ample low cost parking is within three blocks. The Riverwalk, cruise pier, and convention center are right across the street, as is the Julia Street streetcar stop. Several bus stops ...

We stayed here over Memorial Day Weekend for a quick 2 nights, we scored a great deal for $115 a night (great price for a holiday weekend). I liked the hotel, the entrance is lovely when you pull up, has the NOLA feel to it. Everyone from the doormen to front desk staff was nice, especially Theoron (I hope I didn't mess up his name and if I did sorry, team Gemini). It was my Birthday weekend and he made it extra special by sending me a piece of Pecan Chocolate Pie to the room with a note. From what I noticed everything looked clean, even though not new, it was well taken care of. My room was clean as well especially the bathroom. I fell in love with the bathroom, it was spacious, modern, ...

Renovated for real! The entrance is grand: water fountain, palm trees, crescent driveway w/ valet service. However, when I arrived (3p, Thurs.) the valet was nowhere to be found for 4 mins! All else is done very well. The bar, floors (wood panels laid individually!), elegant chandeliers throughout the lobby, brick facades and steel beams inside rooms and outside (classic Nola), and high ceilings. Quiet, yet walkable to Canal st., one block from convention center, and very close to warehouse district bars and restaurants. Although the bar in the lobby is quality. Say hey to Kurt! I think the Omni has one of the best locations in Nola for those who are a little "over" Bourbon St. for 24 hrs...
